items.q: Is Sikhism a blend of Hinduism and Islam?
items.correct: No — it is a distinct religion founded by Guru Nanak with its own beliefs.
items.misconception: Yes, it is just a mix of the two.
items.why: Sikhism teaches its own message, including devotion to one God and equality.

items.q: Do Sikhs worship the Gurus as gods?
items.correct: No — Sikhs worship one God; the Gurus are respected teachers.
items.why: The Guru Granth Sahib is honoured as the living Guru, guiding belief and practice.
